Added: Identity-safe lookup by source ID and parent-scoped administrative searches.
Canonical administrative snapshot validation and reproducible source-change reports.
Optional offline exploration of administrative hierarchy with provenance labels.
Changed: The v2 public API uses the Uganda\Uganda object model instead of the published v1 Uganda\Geo API.
Fixed: Prevent duplicate place names from silently replacing distinct records.
Reject malformed JSON and invalid hierarchy references explicitly.
Data: Treat legacy numeric IDs as package-local identifiers, not verified government codes.
Maintain dated UBOS evidence separately from the bundled historical source snapshot.
Geometry: Provide opt-in public-feature acquisition and reviewed polygon matching without inventing boundaries.
Release geometry assets only when matching, topology, completeness and source reuse gates are verified.
Security: Validate release asset hashes and reject unsafe paths or incomplete inventories.
Documentation: Document v1-to-v2 migration, data provenance and known administrative limitations.
Upgrade: Migrate callers from Uganda\Geo chains to Uganda\Uganda lookups and explicit ambiguity handling.
Verify a real Composer installation from the published v2.0.0 tag before deploying production consumers.
